definitions.route_progress: initial minus final XY goal distance, signed metres
definitions.filter_stop_seconds: duration of all14 candidates rejected by predicted tilt; NOT computation waiting or measured stall
definitions.linear_stall: complete2s window: integrated requested |v|>=.20m, travelled distance/request<=.25, canonical arc progress<=.05m
definitions.turn_stall: complete2s window: all commanded |w|>=.01rad/s and each post-step measured body |wz|<=.5*command
definitions.tip_over: measured gravity tilt>=85deg or tilt_over termination
definitions.time_domain: physics time; host pauses for actual FAST-LIO do not count as STOP seconds

limits: B-only has no A/B causal comparison; no claim that tilt filter improves navigation.
Global mean accuracy acceptable, per-condition maximum accuracy unmet.
Genuine FAST-LIO on ideal simulated sensors, not calibrated real sensor noise/latency.
